WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    sites.riskeval,
    AVG(scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin) AS avg_ratio
  FROM scans
  JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sites.riskeval
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.riskeval,
    step1.avg_ratio,
    step1.avg_ratio - step2.overall_avg AS diff
  FROM step1
  CROSS JOIN step2
  WHERE step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND step1.avg_ratio > step2.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS result_col1,
  AVG(diff) AS result_col2
FROM step3
